independenceNote: Speed-torque graph from ROBOTIS's own e-Manual.
methodNote: Speed and efficiency read off the e-Manual's N-T graph, which ROBOTIS measures under a gradually increasing load. Re-read in November 2026 by pixel position from the graph image the e-Manual page shows: about 0.02 N·m on torque, ±0.5 rpm on speed and ±1 point on efficiency. The graph does not print its voltage; the 12 V rating is assumed.
note: The graph stops at 0.74 N·m, under half of the 1.6 N·m stall figure. Near stall the efficiency trace disagrees with the graph's own current trace: 5% at 0.74 N·m, 7.6 rpm and 1.27 A implies about 9 V, against about 12 V over the middle of the curve. Treat the lowest-speed efficiency as approximate.
